noMenu.body: We did not find an online menu for {restaurantName}, but if you take orders (phone, social media, delivery app), you probably have the same leak as most independent restaurants: 20 to 30% commissions paid on every order, and no portal of your own to sell directly.
steps: We set up your Minerva Flow direct-ordering portal, in your colors.
We install it with you (menu, photos, prices) so you never have to learn a new tool alone.
You keep 100% of every direct order, and the rest of the Minerva ecosystem follows automatically.
noMenu.ctaIntro: No price to decide here, just two simple ways to start:

solution.title: How to Plug This Margin Leak
solution.body: Every order through third-party apps pays 20% to 30% commission. A direct ordering portal recoups that revenue — without altering your menu, recipes, or pricing.
steps: We activate your branded Minerva Flow direct portal — ready in one day.
We connect your Google profile and social pages to this link instead of third-party apps.
0% commission on direct orders — and the rest of the ecosystem (finance, team, inventory) syncs seamlessly.
